shouldOverwrite.description:
If true, the parser will remove any existing {@link AssetClass}es that were generated from definition files
before persisting new ones. This can be very dangerous, and should almost never be necessary. Does not
update or delete {@link ExpectedSensor}s.

srcFolder.description:
The directory to search for `AssetClassDefinition` files.
If not specified, the default is "AssetClassDefinition".
These folders **MUST** be in the `resource` directory.

title:
This type enables specifying configurable parameters that will be used as inputs for the
workflow generated in {@link ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParser#start}.
name: ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParserSpec
